newsitem.title: ESTONIA: C.BANK TO HOST ONE-DAY FINANCE CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK TO HOST ONE-DAY FINANCE CONFERENCE.

text.p: The Bank of Estonia will hold a one day conference to mark the fifth anniversary of the re-introduction of the Estonian kroon on June 18, the bank said on Thursday.
The conference will have a strong focus on Estonia's reforms and the European Union, the bank said in a statement.
The key note address will be given by the governor of the central bank, Vahur Kraft, on Estonia's reforms in the light of the European Union.
Other speakers include Estonian Prime Minister Mart Siimann, Robert Raymond from the European Finance Institute, Stanley Fischer from the International Monetary Fund.
Siimann, who recently took EU integration issues directly under his control, will speak on European intergration.
A panel discussion on the euro and Eastern Europe will be chaired by Ardo Hansson, central bank board member and Siimann's advisor.
